_note: Default fit per garment type for the avatar pack (MVP-03). Every garment size is derived from the wearer's own tape measurements plus the ease and proportions below, so no real-item flat measurements are needed. Changing a value is a reviewed edit: rebuild and run the checks. All lengths in cm unless a name says 'fraction'.
_colour_note: Neutral light grey, sRGB 0-255. The app sets the colour (MVP-06); a light base multiplies cleanly if the app tints the material instead of replacing it.

trousers._note: Regular-fit straight trousers, hem just above the floor.
